title: Re-audit transformations of the SPP1+TAM cross-scale design
plain_language_question: Which scientifically coherent uses of the anchor can produce a beginner-executable manuscript, and what is retained, repaired, replaced, extended, or dropped in each?
biological_unit: Not applicable at the umbrella gate
decisive_evidence: A portfolio with explicit multi-axis change maps, independent assessments, and human-readable trade-offs
falsifier: Fewer than two scientifically coherent and feasible manuscript candidates survive the corrected G0 gates
learning_objective: Learn to compare biological, design, evidence, method, and code reuse without making change count or generic validation the decision rule
target_contribution: A reviewed candidate portfolio rather than an automatically selected audit paper
claim_ceiling: No manuscript claim is authorized by this umbrella direction

title: Cross-cohort transportability and context boundaries of published myeloid states in CRC and CRLM
plain_language_question: Which published CRC or CRLM myeloid programs reproduce across independent patients and spatial datasets?
biological_unit: Patient or independent sample within cohort; independent study for synthesis
decisive_evidence: A cohort-level forest plot with prespecified state mapping and orthogonal spatial localization
falsifier: The state panel cannot be frozen, fewer than three independent cohorts share the main comparison, or patient-level effects do not support a coherent question
learning_objective: Learn metadata lineage, state mapping, replicate-aware inference, evidence synthesis, and spatial validation
target_contribution: A reproducibility and evidence-strength map of published myeloid programs
claim_ceiling: Associational reproducibility, heterogeneity, and spatial localization only

title: External validation of malignancy-linked versus liver-niche-linked immune programs in CRC metastasis
plain_language_question: Which immune programs follow malignant tissue identity and which follow the liver environment across independent CRC metastasis cohorts?
biological_unit: Patient, matched tissue, or independent sample within immune lineage
decisive_evidence: Independent mapping of prespecified malignancy-linked and liver-niche-linked programs across matched tissues and cohorts
falsifier: Study and tissue effects cannot be separated or no independent cohort reproduces the required tissue contrasts
learning_objective: Learn cross-lineage mapping, matched-tissue design, domain shift, and patient-level validation
target_contribution: An externally validated ecological classification of tumor- and organ-associated immune programs
claim_ceiling: Associational ecological alignment only; no lineage origin or causal niche claim

title: Macrophage-program remodeling during neoadjuvant PD-1 therapy in dMMR CRC
plain_language_question: How do prespecified macrophage programs change within patients during neoadjuvant PD-1 treatment, and are changes distinguishable from arm and sampling effects?
biological_unit: Patient with paired or explicitly unpaired treatment samples
decisive_evidence: A patient-aware treatment-change estimate with an independent or orthogonal validation source
falsifier: Treatment arm, pairing, and response cannot be separated or no non-overlapping validation source exists
learning_objective: Learn paired design, response-label auditing, treatment interaction limits, and validation
target_contribution: A modest treatment-context macrophage-remodeling result if dependencies are confirmed
claim_ceiling: Exploratory treatment association only; no efficacy, predictive biomarker, or causal claim

title: Approximate reconstruction of the anchor computational figures
plain_language_question: Which public-data figures can be independently reconstructed, and which discrepancies remain because inputs, code, imaging, or interventions are unavailable?
biological_unit: The anchor's documented patient, sample, or spatial unit for each reconstructed figure
decisive_evidence: A figure-by-figure reconstruction and discrepancy ledger linked to reproducible inputs and runs
falsifier: Public inputs cannot reproduce even the stated qualitative contrasts or provenance remains unresolved
learning_objective: Learn provenance, independent reconstruction, discrepancy reporting, and cross-scale analysis mechanics
target_contribution: A training foundation and reusable adapters, not a stand-alone manuscript
claim_ceiling: Descriptive similarity and documented discrepancies only

title: Tumor-specific versus fibrosis-shared SPP1 macrophage programs in colorectal liver metastasis
plain_language_question: Which parts of the SPP1 macrophage program in CRLM are specific to the metastatic tumor and which are shared with non-malignant liver fibrosis?
biological_unit: Patient-level macrophage pseudobulk within study and patient-level spatial region within tissue
decisive_evidence: A frozen shared-versus-residual program reproduced in at least two CRLM cohorts and two non-malignant liver resources, with the CRLM-residual component associated with CD8 exclusion after ECM, hypoxia, and study controls
falsifier: No stable CRLM-residual program remains after within-study estimation, or the residual does not reproduce or relate to immune exclusion
learning_objective: Learn biological comparator design, patient-level differential-state analysis, cross-study synthesis, spatial validation, and target-specificity reasoning
target_contribution: Separate a potentially targetable CRLM-specific immunosuppressive component from a broadly reparative fibrotic macrophage state
claim_ceiling: Human associational specificity and spatial ecology only; no therapeutic efficacy, synergy, lineage-origin, or causal claim

title: One SPP1 label, two functions: matrix remodeling versus T-cell exclusion in CRLM
plain_language_question: Do matrix-remodeling and T-cell-exclusion programs coexist in the same SPP1 macrophage state, or do they mark separable patient and spatial states in CRLM?
biological_unit: Patient-level macrophage pseudobulk and spatial neighborhood nested within patient
decisive_evidence: Replicate-aware covariance or factor decomposition in independent cohorts plus spatial evidence showing coupling or separation of the two prespecified programs
falsifier: The two programs cannot be measured independently, results are driven by one study or cell quality, or spatial data cannot distinguish their neighborhoods
learning_objective: Learn continuous-state modeling, competing-program controls, patient-level inference, and spatial neighborhood analysis
target_contribution: Clarify whether a widely used SPP1-positive label represents one therapeutic object or multiple biologically distinct macrophage programs
claim_ceiling: Associational program structure and spatial co-occurrence only; no proof that either program causes T-cell dysfunction or treatment resistance

title: SPP1 macrophage states and pathological response after neoadjuvant chemotherapy in CRLM
plain_language_question: Are prespecified SPP1 macrophage programs different between pathological responders and non-responders after neoadjuvant chemotherapy for resectable CRLM?
biological_unit: Patient as the inferential unit, with region or sample nested within patient
decisive_evidence: A prespecified patient-level response contrast with treatment metadata, sensitivity to regimen and sampling region, and a non-overlapping orthogonal validation source
falsifier: Response labels or regimens cannot be separated, the dataset contains only post-treatment cross-sectional samples without a credible comparator, or no validation source exists
learning_objective: Learn treatment-context metadata audit, patient-level response contrasts, confounding control, and modest clinical claim setting
target_contribution: A clinically contextualized association between macrophage state and pathological response if the design survives metadata audit
claim_ceiling: Exploratory response association only; no predictive biomarker, treatment-effect, or causal remodeling claim

title: Simple marker, cell-type, cancer, or pan-cancer substitution in the public-data template
plain_language_question: Can novelty be obtained by replacing SPP1, TAMs, CRC, or the disease scope while retaining the same integration and association template?
biological_unit: Unspecified patient or sample unit inherited from whichever public dataset is chosen
decisive_evidence: A prespecified replacement with a unique biological rationale, unoccupied nearest-neighbor space, and evidence that answers a different consequential question
falsifier: The replacement is selected after seeing public-data availability, repeats an occupied atlas or signature route, or changes labels without changing the estimand
learning_objective: Learn why changing names or adding cancers is not equivalent to a scientific contribution
target_contribution: A screened-out family of mechanical imitation routes used to prevent novelty by relabeling
claim_ceiling: At most descriptive association; therapeutic and mechanistic claims remain prohibited
